segments.title: 第131章 雨露均沾
segments.content:
Reburn: The Verdant Era Chapter 131 Impartial Favor

Sunday morning.

Ying Chanxi woke from her sleep, climbed out of bed and stretched, then patted Pikachu's head and said good morning.

After coming out of the bedroom and quickly washing up in the bathroom, Ying Chanxi came to the living room to find a small bowl of preserved eggs on the dining table, along with a packet of pickled mustard greens and a container of fermented tofu.

A note was stuck to the table.

"Remember to eat breakfast when you wake up. If Senior is also up early, let her have some too. The congee is in the rice cooker."

After reading the note, Ying Chanxi paused for a moment, then turned and walked toward the master bedroom. She knocked, but there was no answer.

She pushed the door open a crack and peeked inside, discovering that Li Luo was not there.

Then she ran to the piano room to check, but didn't see Li Luo there either.

It seemed he had gone out.

Ying Chanxi went to the kitchen to ladle herself a bowl of congee, then sat down at the dining table. While eating breakfast, she gave Li Luo a call.

"Hello? What's up?"

"Where did you go so early in the morning?" Ying Chanxi asked in confusion. "Why do you sound a little out of breath?"

"I went out for a morning run. I'll be back in a bit."

"Are you alone? Or is someone else with you?" Ying Chanxi became alert and immediately asked, "Don't tell me Zhusheng is there too?"

"Why would she be crazy enough to come all the way to our place for a morning run? She doesn't even live at school on weekends," Li Luo said, not knowing whether to laugh or cry. "I'll be back soon."

"Then why didn't you wake me up to go run with you?" Ying Chanxi said, disgruntled. "Going out all sneakily by yourself."

"Who was it that was sulking last night?" Li Luo sounded exasperated. "Saying that I wanted to use the computer but wouldn't just ask you directly, and that I wasn't treating you like one of my own, then stormed back into your room all angry."

"But it's true!"

Originally, after a night's sleep, Ying Chanxi had put the matter out of her mind for the time being.

But now that Li Luo dared to bring it up, she was suddenly furious. "It's not like I have to edit MVs every single day. It wasn't an urgent matter to begin with."

"If you wanted to use the computer, you could have just told me. It's not like I wouldn't let you use it."

"But you told Zhusheng instead and even borrowed her laptop, making it seem like I was deliberately hogging your computer."

As she spoke, even though she hadn't felt aggrieved yesterday, her emotions now got the better of her. The more Ying Chanxi talked, the more upset she became. Her mouth, which had been eating, turned down in a pout, and she nearly talked herself into tears.

"My bad, my bad." Hearing the change in Ying Chanxi's tone, Li Luo quickly begged for mercy and apologized. "Don't cry. If my mom finds out, she'll kill me."

"You're just afraid of Auntie Lin getting mad, so as long as Auntie Lin doesn't know, you'd just let me cry, wouldn't you?" Ying Chanxi blinked her eyes pitifully, which instantly welled up as if tears were about to fall the very next second.

Li Luo: "..."

Damn... Angry girls are so damn hard to placate. Their strange logic comes one wave after another.

"Alright, don't cry." Li Luo sighed. "I still need your help with something."

When a girl is angry, reasoning with her is useless. It's better to find a way to distract her first.

Sure enough, Ying Chanxi only reacted for a moment before subconsciously asking, "Help you with what?"

"Filming an MV," Li Luo said. "I've been hit with a burst of inspiration recently and wrote a new song. I'll sing it for you later."

"Really? That's amazing." Ying Chanxi's attention was immediately diverted, and she asked curiously, "You don't actually have a talent for this, do you?"

"Just wait for me to get back, and you'll know once you hear it."

"Then hurry back. I'm almost done with breakfast."

Around nine in the morning, Xu Youyu yawned and came out of her bedroom. She first went to the bathroom, then came to the living room to forage for food.

Li Luo hadn't returned yet, and only Ying Chanxi was sitting curled up on the sofa, hugging her knees and staring into space. Xu Youyu glanced at the leftover preserved eggs and fermented tofu on the table and asked, "Xixi, was it congee for breakfast?"

"Mhm... There's still some in the kitchen. Senior, you can have a little."

"Where's Li Luo?" Xu Youyu acknowledged her and walked toward the kitchen, asking, "Is he in the bedroom playing on the computer?"

"No, that guy went out for a morning run early this morning," Ying Chanxi said huffily.

"He's that dedicated?" Xu Youyu was surprised. "Does he really think he can win the championship in the 3000-meter race?"

"It'd be a miracle if he did," Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes. "I've seen the registration list for the first-year boys' 3000-meter race. There's a sports student in Class 16 who seems to specialize in long-distance running."

Xu Youyu came out with a bowl of congee. Hearing this, she raised her eyebrows. "You're quite concerned about this. I didn't even look at it closely."

"It's not that I'm concerned, I was just curious and took a look. Otherwise, that guy is always bragging about how he's going to get first place when he's out running, boasting without a second thought."

Just as Ying Chanxi said this, Li Luo happened to open the door and come back.

Hearing her words, he immediately smiled. "How is it that I hear someone badmouthing me the moment I get back?"

"I'm just telling the truth, okay." Seeing him return, Ying Chanxi shot him a glare, but with Xu Youyu present, she restrained her emotions and wasn't as worked up as she had been on the phone.

"Didn't you go for a morning run?" Xu Youyu glanced at the plastic bag in Li Luo's hand and asked strangely, "Why are you carrying something?"

"I bought some small things on my way back after the run." Li Luo smiled and walked straight to the sofa where Ying Chanxi was. He reached out and ruffled her long hair, asking, "Still angry?"

"Who's angry at you?" In front of Xu Youyu, Ying Chanxi tried hard to maintain the demeanor befitting the top student in their grade.

After all, she was now the vice president of the student council and would probably be taking over Xu Youyu's position next year.

She couldn't let her senior think she was a petty person.

However, Xu Youyu was used to their usual banter and just watched the show while eating her breakfast.

Then, she saw Li Luo take out a box, slightly larger than his palm, from the plastic bag and hand it to Ying Chanxi.

"Here, for you."

"What is this?" Ying Chanxi paused, taking the box from Li Luo. She looked at the picture on the packaging and saw it was a camera. "Why did you suddenly buy me a camera?"

"This is an instant camera," Li Luo said. "It's a smaller model, you can hold it in one hand. Plus, it produces the picture immediately after you take it, printing the photo directly. It's pretty convenient."

"Oh, I know about instant cameras." Ying Chanxi's eyes lit up, eager to open it, but before she did, she glanced at Li Luo. "So, uh, I'll open it now?"

"Go ahead." Seeing her expectant look, Li Luo chuckled. "It's a gift for you, open it if you want."

After getting Li Luo's confirmation, Ying Chanxi no longer hesitated. She sat cross-legged on the sofa, held the box with both hands, and began to carefully unbox it.

She didn't dare use much force, only very carefully tearing the seal on the box without damaging the packaging in the slightest.

Once the seals were all removed, she opened the lid with anticipation.

An exquisite, small, and cute-styled instant camera appeared before her eyes.

In addition, the box also contained an instruction manual, matching batteries, and a stack of blank photo paper for exposure and development.

"The camera comes with 30 sheets of blank photo paper." Li Luo took out another small box from the plastic bag. "And this is an extra pack. It should have a hundred sheets inside."

"The sports meet is coming up soon, and it's a bit heavy to carry your video camera around everywhere."

"There will be a lot of people at the sports meet too, so it would be bad if it got bumped and dropped or lost. This instant camera is smaller and more convenient to carry around."

"Over a hundred sheets of photo paper should be enough for you to use until the end of the sports meet."

Ying Chanxi picked up the instant camera from the box, looked at it from left to right, her fingers stroking it back and forth, feeling its texture and weight.

The smile on her face was already unstoppable, clearly very pleased.

But she still said, "I guess you have some conscience after all."

When Li Luo heard her say that, he knew she probably wasn't angry anymore, so he reached out and pinched her cheek. "You're clearly overjoyed, but you're still pretending."

"Let go! I want to figure out how to use this first."

At the dining table, Xu Youyu had already finished her breakfast. Seeing Ying Chanxi's happy and excited expression, she couldn't help but laugh.

Then she looked at Li Luo and teased with a smile, "Being so nice to your childhood friend. I guess I really am the third wheel, huh?"

"Senior, if I ever make you angry one day, I'll buy you one too."

"Then I'm angry right now. Can you conjure up a gift for me?"

"Are you sure?"

"What? You actually have one?" Xu Youyu raised her eyebrows and chuckled.

But in the next second, as if he were Doraemon reaching into his magic pocket, Li Luo stuck his hand into the plastic bag, pulled out a wooden board, and handed it to Xu Youyu.

"Here, this is for you."

"What is this?" Xu Youyu was completely baffled. Staring at the wooden board in front of her, she fell into deep thought for a moment. "If you're going to be perfunctory, just say so. This is worse than giving nothing at all."

"This is a keyboard wrist rest," Li Luo explained to her. "I see you use the computer a lot. Your wrists must hurt after using it for a long time, right?"

"Put this wrist rest in front of the keyboard. Use it to support your wrist when you're typing. It should be more comfortable that way."

"It seems like you haven't used one of these before. I recommend you give it a try."

After hearing Li Luo's explanation, Xu Youyu was stunned.

This was the first time a boy had given her something from such a considerate perspective.

This wooden wrist rest looked plain and simple, but it was indeed very thoughtful.

She didn't remember ever mentioning that her wrists hurt from typing. Could Li Luo have observed such a subtle need from their daily interactions?

But what she didn't know was that in his past life, Li Luo had often heard Xu Youyu complain about her tenosynovitis and lumbar muscle strain.

The back problem wasn't obvious when she was young, but Xu Youyu had been suffering from tenosynovitis since high school.

Li Luo's gift was, in a way, a targeted remedy.

"Take it."

"Oh, okay... Thanks then." Xu Youyu took the wrist rest, glanced at Ying Chanxi on the sofa, then back at Li Luo, before standing up and saying softly, "I'll go try it out."

On the sofa, Ying Chanxi's gaze retracted from Xu Youyu's back. She then looked at the plastic bag in Li Luo's hand and asked with narrowed eyes:

"Li Luo, don't tell me you have something else in that bag?"

(End of Chapter)
